---
title: Appendix with level-2 headings only
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
number-sections: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          dash="$(printf '\342\200\224')"
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qE "1 Intro.*2 Methods.*Appendix A $dash Extra.*A.1 Detail" || { echo "wrong order"; exit 1; }
          for expected in 'Figure A.1: Extra square' 'See Appendix A'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

## Intro

See @sec-extra.

## Extra {.appendix #sec-extra}

![Extra square.](figure.svg){#fig-extra fig-alt="A blue square."}

### Detail

Detail text.

## Methods

The methods.
